items.q: Me, John Williams who was Mary Lou Williams' husband, and Joe Jones who thought he could play checkers.

ctx.x: Clyde Hart. I asked Clyde, because I used to play checkers with Clyde every night. Me, John Williams who was Mary Lou Williams' husband, and Joe Jones who thought he could play checkers. And this was every night. So I prevailed upon Clyde to come by rehearsal, and he played and eventually he just started working with us. You know, but Lester, yes. This is why I told you when I saw him after the war, I detected right away that something had happened to him. I could see it right away, because I knew him so well.
